== Description ==

[[Steve Harpster]] (left, grey hair, beard, glasses, black jacket) and [[Chris Wirfs]] (right, glasses, black ''Han Solo'' T-shirt) during the Friday-evening Team Tournament at the [[2025 World Championship]] in SeaTac, Washington, on 3 October 2025.
